# Young Black Dragon (`monsters:young-black-dragon`)
*Large dragon, chaotic evil* | **CR** 7 (XP 2,900; PB +3)
**AC** 18 | **HP** 127 (15d10 + 45) | **Speed** 40 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
**STR** 19 (+4) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 17 (+3) | **INT** 12 (+1) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 15 (+2)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +5, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +3
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +6, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +5
**Damage Immunities:** acid
**Senses:** Darkvision 120 ft., Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 16
**Languages:** Common, Draconic

## Traits
- **Amphibious.** The dragon can breathe air and water.

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The dragon makes three Rend attacks.
- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage.
- **Acid Breath (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 49 (14d6) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
